dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I haven't got time for that at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Oh, I get it, you're one of those "people with things to do," like my dad and mom.

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Grandpa says that you shouldn't trouble people like that, so I won't bother you anymore. I'll play by myself.

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: I'm very good at that — even playing by myself can be a super fun thing!

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Well, I guess it's Super Fun Thing Number 2. Number 1 is when Navia comes around!
